name: ci-workflows-classifier-deps
description: Build-only manifest for .github/scripts/classifier-deps.mjs. Pins the exact dependency tree vendored into that bundle; package-lock.json beside it pins the transitives too. Never installed at run time — scripts/build-classifier-deps.sh copies these two files into a scratch dir, runs `npm ci`, and bundles the result. To change a version, edit it here and re-run that script.
